macros.name: getabspath
macros.doc: With \getabspath{〈file name〉} the absolute path of the given file is read from the ‘.fls’ file and stored in \theabspath.

macros.name: getmainfile
macros.doc: With \getmainfile the name of the main file is read from the ‘.fls’ file and stored in \themainfile.

macros.name: getpwd
macros.doc: The parent working directory (PWD) is read by \getpwd from the ‘.fls’ file and stored in \thepwd.

macros.name: theabsdir
macros.doc: The directory component (path without file name) is stored in \theabsdir.

macros.name: themainfile
macros.doc: With \getmainfile the name of the main file is read from the ‘.fls’ file and stored in \themainfile.

macros.name: thepwd
macros.doc: The parent working directory (PWD) is read by \getpwd from the ‘.fls’ file and stored in \thepwd.
